transcriptionContext:
This is a voice-dictation recording of one person. The recording may contain background noise and other people's voices; the main speaker's speech is the dictation. The speaker may switch between Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) and English.

這是一段單一使用者的語音輸入錄音。錄音中可能含有背景雜音與其他人的聲音，主要說話者的話語才是輸入內容。說話者可能在繁體中文（台灣）與英文之間切換。
